text: Hello everyone, welcome to our English class.I'm Hu Jiawei.Nice to see you again.Boys and girls, you met a lot of friends in Unit 2.For example, old friends and new friends, human friends and animal friends, and the most special one, the earth.Well, today, you are going to review what you've learned in Unit 2.Before we start our lesson, please make sure you have these things.Your student's book, your notebook, worksheet and pens.请准备好你的课本,笔记本,学习单,和笔。Are you ready?Ok, now let's start.Rose Garden School is celebrating Friendship Day today.The students can go to different classrooms to play games and win medals.Let's go with Kitty and Alice.In Class 1, you need to help underlined letters to find their phonetic friends.Please take out your worksheet and finish Task 1.Have you finished?Let's check.Number 1.Friendly.Choose A.Just.Choose B.Reuse.Pollute.If you get all the answers right, you can get a medal.Look, here are two passages about friends.Can you complete them with the proper forms of the words in the box?Please finish Task 2 on your worksheet.Time is up.My friend Lisa is a beautiful girl.She is very helpful.She tries her best to help all the people around her.She is also friendly.She always wears a sweet smile.She never shouts at others.Our friend the Earth is not healthy or happy now.There is a lot of pollution because some people pollute it.To help our friend, we must make promises to keep the environment clean.For example, we can promise to reuse shopping bags.Another medal for you if you have done a good job.Now, you are in Class 2.You are going to listen to a dialogue between Tom and his American friend Lucy.Please take out your worksheet and look at Task 3.Tick where Lucy has been and hasn't been.Let's start.Lucy, you've been in Garden City for a week.What do you think of it?It's very clean and beautiful.I like it.Oh, I'm glad to hear that.There are many interesting places in our city.Have you been to Ocean Park yet?Yes, I've just been to Ocean Park.I love the cute dolphins.What about Water World?Have you been there yet?No, I haven't been there yet.It's really fun to play water games there.You can't miss it.Have you been to Sunny Town yet?Yes, I've already been there.It's quiet and peaceful.And people there are friendly.What about Golden City Zoo?I'm going there tomorrow.Have you got the answers?If you haven't, don't worry.Please listen again.Has Lucy been to Ocean Park yet?Yes, she has just been to Ocean Park.No, she hasn't been to Water World yet.Has she been to Sunny Town yet?Yes, she has already been there.What about Garden City Zoo?No, she hasn't been there yet.Did you get all the answers right?I hope so.Now, suppose you are Lucy.Talk about where you have been and haven't been in Garden City according to the table.You can start.This is Alice's work.Let's read it together.I have been in Garden City for a week.I have just been to Ocean Park.I love the dolphins there.I haven't been to Water World yet.I have already been to Sunny Town.It is quiet and peaceful.I haven't been to Garden City Zoo yet.Good job, Alice.Here are some pictures about Friends of the Earth.Please tell what Friends of the Earth do and why they do it.You will have one minute to prepare.This is Kitty's work.Friends of the Earth look after the environment.Nowadays, some people pollute the environment.We have a lot of pollution.Friends of the Earth do many good things to help keep the environment clean.For example, they pick up rubbish and put it into rubbish bins.They tell people not to leave rubbish too.Good job, Kitty.Please write down your promises to look after the environment in your school and in your community.Community means 社区.These pictures are for your reference.Let's read it togetherFriends of the Earth look after the environment.Let's read it togetherHave you finished?Let's take a look at Alice and Kitty's work.Our promises at school.We promise to keep our school clean.We promise to turn off the lights before leaving the classroom.We promise not to draw on the desks.In the community, we promise to clean up for our dogs.This sentence means,我们承诺为我们的宠物狗清理粪便。We promise to do the rubbish sorting.This sentence means,我们承诺做好垃圾分类。We promise not to pick flowers.Alice and Kitty have done a good job.Now you are in class five.Suppose these are your friends.Tell what you like about them according to the cards.Let's take a look at Kitty and Alice's work.Mary is my good friend.She is always friendly.She is never late for school.Sam is my good friend.He is always active.He never gets angry.Tom is my good friend.He always works hard.He is never naughty.Jane is my good friend.She is always kind to others.She never shows off.Excellent job, Alice and Kitty.Boys and girls, take a look at these sentences.When you use them, what should you pay attention to?Yes, you should pay attention to where to put these adverbs of frequency.Do you still remember the rules?Yes, you've got it.Alice and Never are placed before the action and non-action adverbs.Good job.Now, please write about your good friend according to the checklist.You can write about your human friend or animal friend.Remember to write at least five sentences about your good friend.Don't forget to use words of frequency such as always, often, sometimes and never correctly.This is Kitty's writing about her friend Alice.Alice is my good friend.She is always friendly and helpful.She often teaches me English and sometimes helps me with Chinese.She is never impatient.She is always honest and never tells lies.We always help each other.I like Alice very much.Did she write at least five sentences about her good friend?Did she use words of frequency such as always, often, sometimes and never correctly?This is Alice's writing about her pet friend Meatball.This makes me happy.I like Meatball very much.Alice wrote nine sentences about her pet friend and she used always, often and never correctly.Excellent work, Alice.Alice and Kitty have won seven medals.How many medals have you got?I hope you've done a good job just like Alice and Kitty.Boys and girls, let's sum up.In today's lesson, you've reviewed what you learned in Unit 2.You've also got a deeper understanding of the word friend.At class, please complete the exercises on your homework sheet.So much for today.See you next time.
